title: Fleet Contact Engineer - Istanbul
desc:
Founded in 1960 in the UK, REED has grown continuously and become a leading brand both in the UK and the international arena. Today REED has 350 offices with more than 3.000 employees and is providing services across 20 specialist sectors. We work closely with experienced and qualified professionals across a wide range of industry sectors, delivering bespoke recruitment solutions on a variety of roles for mid and senior level.
As Reed Turkey, we are looking for a "
Fleet Contact Engineer
" with below requirements for our global client operating in automotive industry.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering departments
New graduated or 1 year experience
Excellent command of written and spoken English
Native-level proficiency in Turkish
Strong analytical and problem solving & negotiation skills, communication skills and high sense of responsibility
Advance knowledge of MS Office applications especially in Excel
Job Description
Obtaining data through tire measurements (tread depth, inflation pressure, wear pictures) as input for further (internal) data processing and analyzing tires
Creating snapshot of tire and vehicle status to identify sales opportunities and improvement potential at fleets
Visiting fleets regularly and preparing reports to technical customer services and sales team
Being contact person for fleet services
Providing technical trainings and supporting fleet customers in this sense
Conducting training and supporting on digital solution installations when required
Providing technical support and expertise for life cycle management processes
